newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta says HK visa extension no longer problem.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta says HK visa extension no longer problem.

text.p: Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said on Wednesday that Hong Kong workers in Indonesia could extend their visas following an assurance that their travel documents would remain valid after the territory reverts to China on June 30.
"We have an assurance from the Chinese government that there will be no change in status...their documents will remain valid," Alatas told reporters.
He said it was important for Jakarta to know the status of Hong Kong workers in Indonesia after China took over Hong Kong from British rule.
"How could we extend their visas if their documents were not valid. Now, we have no problem in extending their visas if needed," he said.

Indonesian immigration officals said on Monday that Jakarta would ask some 60,000 Hong Kong people working in Indonesia to leave by June because their travel documents might not be valid after China took over the British colony.
But Hong Kong authorities assured Jakarta the same day that travel documents would remain valid after Hong Kong reverted to China.
